ticket.subject: Webhook integration stopped sending events
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

Writing on behalf of Quillmoor GmbH. Our CRM sync stopped working after your last release: no new events have arrived since then.

The webhook settings still show the endpoint as active, and the test button returns success. Our sales team depends on this sync, and we have no other way to move the data.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Can you check the delivery logs for our workspace?

Kind regards,
Hanna

label_notes: clean bug (bug-integration-sync): a core workflow is broken for one customer with no workaround, so P2; urgency medium: action needed this week.
